messages:
ryan: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector swap yesterday we're seeing a 15-25% tail latency regression on the small-request path. traces + profile below. cc @maria @jess
maria: saw that in the dashboards, looks like batches are smaller and KV hit rate dropped. can you paste qps + token mix?
ryan: qps ~1200, median tokens/request ~20, p95 tokens ~140. kv_hit_rate fell to 0.78 from ~0.92. main diffs: kernel v12 -> v13 (matmul pack optim) and coalesce jitter default bumped from 2ms -> 6ms.
jess: that jitter increase could fragment micro-windows. if jitter > coalesce_delay we see more single-request batches which kills kv locality and causes kernel switches. quick thought: lower jitter and nudge microbatch interval.
ryan: quick profile sample:
```
# perf top (aggregate)
kernel_v13            48% cycles
kv_lookup             12% cycles
coalesce_wait         9%  cycles
other                 31% cycles
```
sam: timeline shows more kernel churn when batches mix short+long sequences. can we add a seq-length bucketing on enqueue? small(<64) vs large(>=64) to avoid switching kernels mid-batch.
maria: +1 for bucketing. proposed heuristics: small bucket: coalesce_jitter=1ms, microbatch_interval=8ms, token_budget=256. large bucket: coalesce_jitter=3ms, microbatch_interval=4ms, token_budget=2048. keeps smalls aggressive and large waits slightly longer to fill.
jess: sounds reasonable. also reduce global default jitter to 1-2ms until we validate kernel_v13 behaves.
infra-bot: canary deploy started: runtime/serve:v2026-03-17-kernelexp -> 10% hosts (rollout id: canary-304) :rocket:
ryan: experiment plan I'm going to run on the canary: A) seq-bucket + jitter small=1ms/microbatch=8ms/token=256; B) control (current jitter=6ms, microbatch=4ms). measure: p95 latency, kv_hit_rate, kernel_switch_count, and per-host cpu cycles over 2h.
maria: when you post results, include my little converter for logs -> kernel assignments. makes kernel_switch_count trivial to compute.
ryan: rolling now, will collect flamegraphs & kv metrics. quick extraction command I used:
```
# map request -> kernel assignment
grep "assign_kernel" /var/log/runtime.log | awk -F' ' '{print $2, $6}' | sort | uniq -c
```
jess: ok. success criteria: p95 improved >=6% and kv_hit_rate back to >=0.9. if not, revert kernel_v13 on canary and iterate on kernel patch.
sam: noted. also watch for increased tail CPU on large requests — token_budget misconfig can push a single large batch to thrash kernels.
ryan: will post results in ~2h. thanks all :thumbsup:
